description: Hidden construction default values per module type and condition. Drives default-candidate selection and required-question marking during input understanding and construction.

columns.name: module_type
columns.description: Module type this default applies to, e.g. carcass, drawer, door.

columns.name: parameter
columns.description: Construction parameter name, e.g. back_insert_thickness_mm, shelf_count.

columns.name: default_value
columns.description: Default value for the parameter. Nullable only when resolution_mode is REQUIRED_QUESTION.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit of measure for the default value, e.g. mm, pcs.

columns.name: resolution_mode
columns.description: How the parameter is resolved during input understanding: DEFAULT_CANDIDATE provides a default that may be accepted; REQUIRED_QUESTION forces a clarifying question.

columns.name: confirmation_required
columns.description: Whether the user must confirm the default before it is applied.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the rule is currently active.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Human-readable description of the default rule.

columns.name: rule_id
columns.description: Stable machine identifier of the default rule. Used for stable joins; never edited by users.
